content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Fayetteville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires only a secondary degree and project management education—no work experience necessary. Whether you're entering the field or building credentials, verify you meet PMI's baseline requirements before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's course.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. This intensive format covers PMBOK® Guide essentials and exam domains in a compressed schedule, allowing you to balance certification training with your current role in Fayetteville's military, healthcare, or logistics sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, apply directly to PMI with proof of your education hours. Pay the associated exam fee and allow time for PMI to process and approve your candidacy before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study guides tailored to CAPM domains. Schedule your test when you feel confident, then sit for the proctored exam to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM certification lasts three years. Earn professional development units through training, volunteer work, or industry involvement to renew. Plan your PDU strategy early so renewal is seamless as you advance your career in project management.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
